known_issues.description: The reachable gated-review server has no credential issuer or bearer validator in its checked-out implementation. Live initialization and tools/list with a deliberately invalid bearer returned HTTP 200 for both builder and assessor, rather than the required 401/403. Actual tool names and statuses are committed in observation/verification/gated-review.json; no credentials were fabricated and the gated check was not weakened. Its operator must add credential issuance/validation.

The original task publication secret was refused with HTTP 401 (publication secret refused). Parent runtime readback shows the builder attempt already succeeded. The pr update was not recorded, so build_result was not submitted out of order; current credentials are required to republish these prepared artifacts.

PR #771 is open and non-draft at the pushed branch, with 5 open review threads. Its original description predates this follow-up; gated-review exposes no PR-body edit tool. Current implementation and evidence are documented in observation/verification/README.md.
